title: Paused-queue card labels the abort-path and bind-deferred automatic retries as an Engram hold
outcome: ui/src/panels/queue-pause-cause.ts (resolveQueuePauseCause, ~:41) treats every preview starting with 'Engram' that is not the admission-retry prefix as engramHeld. The abort-path automatic retry ('Engram: delivery not attempted; retrying automatically at <RFC 3339>.', src/engram_abort_retry.rs:277-280) and the bind-deferred retry ('Engram: bind deferred before delivery; waiting for durable automatic retry.', src/engram_bind_retry.rs:403) therefore show 'Engram is holding the queue' with a raw RFC 3339 time. Recognise these as automatic-retry causes and format the time locally.
acceptance: Paused-queue card labels the abort-path and bind-deferred automatic retries as an Engram hold is done
